evals.name: log-wisp-sprite
evals.prompt: cria o sprite do LOG WISP (inimigo da floresta, ta em api/catalog/combat.json) no estilo da keyart pra gente trocar o glyph na BattleScene depois
evals.expected_output: One 32x32 transparent sprite PNG of a wisp-like log/ghost enemy, ink-outlined, palette-locked, plus its spec
assertions: A final PNG asset was produced
Every asset uses a standard size for its category
Every opaque pixel uses a color from the key-art palette
No semi-transparent pixels
A reproducible source (spec or script) was saved next to the PNG
Asset sits on a transparent background
Outline is at least 90% ink (#060612), like the key art

evals.name: shop-icon-set
evals.prompt: preciso dos ícones dos itens da loja (api/catalog/shop.json): café expresso, fone com cancelamento e moletom confortável. tem que parecer tudo do mesmo jogo da keyart
evals.expected_output: Three 16x16 (or 24x24) icons with consistent outline, light direction and fill ratio
assertions: A final PNG asset was produced
Every asset uses a standard size for its category
Every opaque pixel uses a color from the key-art palette
No semi-transparent pixels
A reproducible source (spec or script) was saved next to the PNG
Asset sits on a transparent background
Outline is at least 90% ink (#060612), like the key art
Three icons were produced, all the same size

evals.name: server-room-background
evals.prompt: gera o fundo da ServerScene: uma sala de servidores escura com racks e LEDs piscando, mesma pegada da keyart
evals.expected_output: One opaque 320x180 background PNG with racks, LEDs, dark stone/metal palette, calm middle band
assertions: A final PNG asset was produced
Every asset uses a standard size for its category
Every opaque pixel uses a color from the key-art palette
No semi-transparent pixels
A reproducible source (spec or script) was saved next to the PNG
Background is fully opaque
Bright green/blue LED pixels are present (>= 20)
